## Well Lived Citizen LA — Secondary Brand Concept

**What it is:** A secondary brand name and domain concept. Looser, more neighborhood-native, more LA. Works as an Instagram handle, a local referral shorthand, and a future expansion vehicle if the business grows into a collective or editorial direction.

**Domain:** welllivedcitizen.com / welllivedcitizen.la (check availability)

**How it relates to the primary brand:**
- *A Well Lived Citizen* is the formal, full-name brand — used on the website, business cards, Google, Yelp, and legal documents.
- *Well Lived Citizen LA* is the casual, social, neighborhood version — used on Instagram, local Facebook groups, Nextdoor, and referral contexts where "A Well Lived Citizen" feels too formal.

**Tagline options for the secondary brand:**
- *Well Lived Citizen LA — The physical side of life changes.*
- *Well Lived Citizen LA — Your space. Your stuff. Your next chapter.*
- *Well Lived Citizen LA — Dayna Brown, Los Angeles.*

**Instagram handle options (check availability):**
- @welllivedcitizen
- @welllivedcitizen.la
- @awelllivedcitizen

**Recommended use:**
Keep the primary brand (A Well Lived Citizen) as the legal and web identity. Use Well Lived Citizen LA as the social and referral shorthand. If the business expands — editorial content, a second organizer, a Substack, a product line — Well Lived Citizen LA becomes the umbrella.

## Formspree Setup (one-time task before launch)

1. Go to [formspree.io](https://formspree.io) and create a free account with dayna@awelllivedcitizen.com
2. Create a new form — name it "A Well Lived Citizen Contact"
3. Copy the form ID (looks like `xkgwvqzb`)
4. In the site code, the endpoint is already set to `https://formspree.io/f/xkgwvqzb` — swap that ID with your real one
5. Submit a test message from the contact page and confirm it arrives in your inbox
6. Free plan: 50 submissions/month. Upgrade to $10/month for unlimited.

*Alternative if Formspree is not preferred: use [Web3Forms](https://web3forms.com) — also free, no account required, just an access key.*

## Launch Hygiene Checklist

- [ ] Formspree form ID swapped in Contact.tsx and tested
- [ ] Google Business Profile created and verified (takes 1–5 days for postcard verification)
- [ ] Yelp business page claimed and description pasted
- [ ] Photo of Dayna added to About page
- [ ] Logo added (or confirm text treatment is final)
- [ ] awelllivedcitizen.com domain confirmed pointing to published site
- [ ] Submit sitemap to Google Search Console: https://search.google.com/search-console → Add property → Submit sitemap.xml
- [ ] Test contact form on mobile — confirm submission and email receipt
- [ ] Test floating call button on iPhone (tap → dials)
- [ ] Share the link with 3 people you trust and ask: "Does this make sense in 10 seconds?"
